build_progress_bar_tqdm: build a tqdm progress bar wrapper around an iterator with epoch and prefix logging
build_progress_bar_json: build a JSON format progress bar that logs stats at configurable intervals during iteration
create_progress_bar_tensorboard: create a TensorBoard progress bar wrapper that logs scalar metrics to a log directory
create_progress_bar_wandb: create a Weights and Biases progress bar wrapper that logs training stats to a W&B project
refactor_format_stat: refactor the format_stat function to convert AverageMeter, TimeMeter, and tensor stats to strings
